acceptance_test: No frame with two centre words in any rendered video; owner confirmation that the clean cut is wanted.
candidate_rule:
problem: Two centre words share frames at a cut.
implementation: Derive each word's clip duration from the next cut (W2_OVERLAP = 0) and check frame by frame that exactly one word is visible.
use_when: Sequential centre words on hard cuts.
avoid_when: A deliberate cross-fade between words is part of the brief.
cause_hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] The overlap is an authoring slip in v7 (w2 duration not updated when the cut moved), not a design choice; the reference cuts cleanly.
problem_evidence: Inherited from approved v7: Free* lasts 0.87 s and Storage cuts in 0.83 s later, so both words are on screen for 1-2 frames (v7 frames 91-92; visible at 3.00 s in 05-c3-negro). Kept in all 8 to stay faithful to the approval; reported to the owner.
